scope: Independent new passive release assessment of exact frozen Oct16 candidate; no retuning or model promotion

input.operator_cart_restraint: Operator held cart by hand as instructed and replied done and clear after three releases; camera pivot will be checked separately.
input.selection_method: Selected from unscored strided raw encoder/image-angle preview and confirmed operator protocol, before any new-release model prediction. Start after the clear hand-hold-to-free-oscillation transition; stop at final moving half-cycle before the static tail. No model residual was used.

secondary_coulomb_ode.scope: Predeclared secondary ODE diagnostic only, no acceptance or selection; distinct from primary MuJoCo viscous model

predeclaration.scope: Optional secondary diagnostic only; previously fit on Oct16 train02, old validation now development; new manual data not read. No selection or promotion based on new results. Primary viscous coefficients unchanged. Short and continuous frozen ODE; no Coulomb MuJoCo claim.

source_frames.source: raw vision.pivot_px only; mirrored/fused fields ignored

receipt_proxy.caveat: Board acquisition snapshot to host receipt proxy. Slope includes receipt jitter/trend; intercept includes unmeasured transport. Camera t is host-read, not exposure time.

encoder_period_host_proxy.center_method: within-episode median, only for descriptive crossing timing; never applied to frozen forecasts
encoder_period_host_proxy.caveat: Missing crossings remain missing and may produce multi-cycle intervals; period variation also reflects finite amplitude, damping, offsets and sensing.
